claims.claim: A 2025 FBI email says a complete scrub found Epstein-associated documents not included in a 50D case file.
The sender said the records were outside the case file because they were not of evidentiary value.
Visible attachment descriptions include a 1996 FD-71, 2019 operations-order material and a 2016 FD-71.
The email does not establish destruction or improper suppression of evidence.
